mapper.insert: MERGE INTO XXL_JOB_LOG_REPORT t USING ( SELECT #{triggerDay,jdbcType=DATE} AS TRIGGER_DAY, #{runningCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS RUNNING_COUNT, #{sucCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS SUC_COUNT, #{failCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AS FAIL_COUNT FROM DUAL ) s ON (t.TRIGGER_DAY = s.TRIGGER_DAY) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET t.RUNNING_COUNT = s.RUNNING_COUNT, t.SUC_COUNT = s.SUC_COUNT, t.FAIL_COUNT = s.FAIL_COUNT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (TRIGGER_DAY, RUNNING_COUNT, SUC_COUNT, FAIL_COUNT) VALUES (s.TRIGGER_DAY, s.RUNNING_COUNT, s.SUC_COUNT, s.FAIL_COUNT)
mapper.select: SELECT FROM XXL_JOB_LOG_REPORT t WHERE t.TRIGGER_DAY between #{triggerDayFrom,jdbcType=DATE} and #{triggerDayTo,jdbcType=DATE} ORDER BY t.TRIGGER_DAY ASC
SELECT SUM(RUNNING_COUNT) RUNNING_COUNT, SUM(SUC_COUNT) SUC_COUNT, SUM(FAIL_COUNT) FAIL_COUNT FROM XXL_JOB_LOG_REPORT t
